items.title: 52220_Woody Herman oral history interview
items.q: I kept a tenor player, Gordon -- [Pierce] Brisker. And so at least if we could get in and out of things, if we needed to have a band in 20 minutes, we could do something.

ctx.x: because I once again was running out of gas. And I took a small group on the road. But I managed to hang out to what -- my key personnel in this small group, as far -- and it was a strange kind of small-group thing because it was like an act. But I kept the players that I felt I needed at the time, and that was Nat in the rhythm section, and the same rhythm section we had had in the band a little earlier. And I kept Bill Chase with me and I kept a tenor player, Gordon -- [Pierce]
Brisker. And so at least if we could get in and out of things, if we needed to have a band in 20 minutes, we could do something.
